trips.title: gamescom Bergisch Gladbach weekend
trips.summary: A three-day gamescom plan rebuilt from the 2024 Gmail evidence: reuse Kardinal Schulte Haus in Bergisch Gladbach, keep arrival day slow through the Rhine/Sieg and Cologne green corridors, ride a scenic loop to Koelnmesse on the event morning, then use the third day for Altenberg and an evening train home.

preparation.title: Choose and buy the gamescom day ticket
preparation.detail: The draft uses Thursday, 27 August 2026 inside the official 26-30 August gamescom window. Gmail confirms the 2024 pattern had a Friday day ticket plus a Saturday evening ticket; for this calmer 3-day version, choose one full visitor day first and add an evening ticket only if you want a second short visit.

preparation.title: Book Berlin to Bonn with bicycle space
preparation.detail: Prefer a morning ICE to Bonn Hbf with a long-distance bicycle reservation. The 2024 Gmail evidence used overnight FlixBus to Cologne/Bonn Airport; this plan switches to rail and starts the bicycle day south of Cologne so the ride to Bergisch Gladbach has enough room to breathe.

preparation.title: Reserve Kardinal Schulte Haus again
preparation.detail: Gmail confirms the 2024 gamescom stay at Kardinal Schulte Haus, Overather Strasse 51-53, 51429 Bergisch Gladbach, from 23 to 25 August 2024. For 2026, book two nights, ask about secure bicycle storage, and keep the 14:00 check-in / 10:00 checkout pattern in mind.

preparation.title: Keep KVB line 1 as the evening fallback
preparation.detail: After gamescom, ride back if you still have energy. Otherwise use KVB line 1 from Koelnmesse/Deutz toward Bensberg and finish with the short bicycle climb to the hotel. Confirm bicycle rules and late service before the trip.

preparation.title: Book Cologne to Berlin evening train with bicycle space
preparation.detail: Choose a late-afternoon or early-evening ICE from Koeln Hbf or Koeln Messe/Deutz on Friday, 28 August, leaving enough room for the Altenberg morning ride and a calm station buffer.

preparation.title: Review Bergisch Gladbach bicycle corridors
preparation.detail: The draft targets a relaxed arrival ride of roughly 3-4 hours, an event-day ride around 2 hours before Koelnmesse, and a third-day Bergisches Land finale before the evening train.

checkpoints.title: Berlin Hbf
checkpoints.subtitle: Morning ICE to Bonn Hbf - exact connection to book
checkpoints.detail: Book a bicycle space and keep a wide platform buffer. Gmail shows the 2024 trip used overnight FlixBus to Cologne/Bonn Airport, but the app plan should prefer rail for a bicycle weekend.

checkpoints.title: Rhine and Sieg approach
checkpoints.subtitle: Bonn Hbf to Wahner Heide / Koenigsforst pause - 36 km
checkpoints.detail: Leave Bonn without hurry, follow the Rhine/Sieg side north, then bend toward the heath and forest corridors. This keeps the first day closer to a proper half-day ride.

checkpoints.title: Wahner Heide or Koenigsforst pause
checkpoints.subtitle: Lunch, water and weather buffer
checkpoints.detail: Keep this loose: if the morning train is late, shorten the heath loop and make this a simple cafe or bakery stop before Bensberg.

checkpoints.title: Koenigsforst to Bensberg
checkpoints.subtitle: Forest edge to Kardinal Schulte Haus - 15 km
checkpoints.detail: Finish through Koenigsforst and Bensberg. Keep the last climb gentle, then check in without rushing.

checkpoints.title: Kardinal Schulte Haus
checkpoints.subtitle: Bergisch Gladbach check-in - same hotel as gamescom 2024
checkpoints.detail: Same hotel confirmed in Gmail for 23-25 August 2024: Kardinal Schulte Haus, Overather Strasse 51-53, 51429 Bergisch Gladbach. For 2026, book two nights and reconfirm secure bicycle storage.

checkpoints.title: Dinner in Bensberg
checkpoints.subtitle: Hotel restaurant or Bensberg old-town alternative
checkpoints.detail: Use the first evening for food, charging and a quick check of the event-day route. Avoid turning this into another logistics project.

checkpoints.title: Bensberg loop to Koelnmesse
checkpoints.subtitle: Kardinal Schulte Haus to Koelnmesse via Koenigsforst and Rheinpark - 24 km
checkpoints.detail: A scenic but controlled event-morning ride. Start early, keep one cafe/water stop optional, and arrive before the entry queues become annoying.

checkpoints.title: gamescom 2026
checkpoints.subtitle: Koelnmesse - Thursday private visitor day
checkpoints.detail: Official Thursday private visitor opening hours are 10:00-20:00. Keep the ticket, power bank and bicycle parking plan close at hand.

checkpoints.title: Koelnmesse/Deutz
checkpoints.subtitle: KVB line 1 toward Bensberg if the evening ride is too much
checkpoints.detail: Fallback after the exhibition. Confirm current KVB bicycle rules; if the day still feels good, ride the full way back instead.

checkpoints.title: Bensberg to hotel
checkpoints.subtitle: Short evening finish from the Stadtbahn stop - 1 km
checkpoints.detail: Only the final short climb if you used the KVB fallback. Keep lights easy to reach.

checkpoints.title: Altenberg and Cologne finale
checkpoints.subtitle: Kardinal Schulte Haus to Koeln Hbf via Altenberger Dom - 43 km
checkpoints.detail: Check out after breakfast, ride through the Bergisches Land toward Altenberg, then roll back to Cologne with a generous station buffer.

checkpoints.title: Koeln Hbf
checkpoints.subtitle: Evening ICE to Berlin Hbf - exact connection to book
checkpoints.detail: Book a long-distance bicycle space early. The wide buffer protects the day-three ride from delays, lunch and a last relaxed stop.

trips.title: SPIEL Essen Ruhr weekend
trips.summary: A three-day SPIEL Essen plan based on the 2025 mailbox evidence: DB with bicycle reservation, the same Hotel Zum Hackstueck in Hattingen, arrival on Wednesday for a slow Ruhr ride, Thursday for the exhibition, then a relaxed Friday ride before an evening train from Essen to Berlin.

preparation.title: Buy the SPIEL Essen Thursday ticket when sales open
preparation.detail: The draft uses Thursday, 22 October 2026, the first day of the official 22-25 October SPIEL window. Gmail shows you bought a Thursday SPIEL Essen 2025 day ticket, so keep the same pattern for 2026.

preparation.title: Book Berlin to Essen with bicycle space
preparation.detail: Gmail evidence from 2025 used Berlin Hbf 04:23 to Essen Hbf 08:40 with seat and bicycle reservation. For the calmer 3-day 2026 plan, prefer a morning ICE to Essen or Dortmund with bicycle space and a less brutal start if available.

preparation.title: Reserve two nights at Hotel Zum Hackstueck
preparation.detail: Use the same hotel confirmed in Gmail for SPIEL 2025: Hotel Zum Hackstueck, Hackstueckstr. 123, 45527 Hattingen. The 2025 booking was one night, Thursday 23 October to Friday 24 October, with breakfast included; for this calmer 2026 plan book two nights from Wednesday 21 October to Friday 23 October and reconfirm bicycle storage plus late-return instructions.

preparation.title: Confirm Essen to Hattingen evening bicycle carriage
preparation.detail: After the exhibition, ride to Essen Hbf and use a regional connection toward Hattingen. Confirm the bicycle ticket and the final construction-adjusted timetable.

preparation.title: Book Essen to Berlin evening train with bicycle space
preparation.detail: Gmail evidence from 2025 used Essen Hbf to Berlin Hbf with bicycle reservation and an evening ICE 645. Keep the same idea for 2026: depart from Essen in the late afternoon or early evening after the third-day ride.

preparation.title: Review RuhrtalRadweg and Baldeneysee sections
preparation.detail: The draft gives about four riding hours on arrival day and about two hours from the scenic hotel area to Messe Essen. Import a preferred GPX after checking weather and construction.

checkpoints.title: Berlin Hbf
checkpoints.subtitle: Morning ICE to Essen or Dortmund - exact connection to book
checkpoints.detail: Gmail confirms the 2025 pattern: Berlin Hbf to Essen Hbf with seat and bicycle reservation. For 2026, choose Essen or Dortmund based on the best bicycle-space connection, then keep the arrival ride relaxed.

checkpoints.title: Ruhr lake approach
checkpoints.subtitle: Dortmund Hbf to Kemnader See - 46 km
checkpoints.detail: Leave Dortmund calmly, join the river corridor near Hengsteysee and use Kemnader See as the main lunch pause.

checkpoints.title: Kemnader See
checkpoints.subtitle: Lunch and weather buffer
checkpoints.detail: Keep a proper pause before the final hotel section. Shorten the lake detour if autumn weather turns poor.

checkpoints.title: RuhrtalRadweg to Hattingen
checkpoints.subtitle: Kemnader See to Zum Hackstueck - 17 km
checkpoints.detail: Follow the Ruhr corridor toward Hattingen and finish with the short climb to the hotel. Keep lights accessible in October.

checkpoints.title: Hotel-Restaurant Zum Hackstueck
checkpoints.subtitle: Hattingen check-in - same hotel as SPIEL 2025
checkpoints.detail: Same hotel found in Gmail: Hotel Zum Hackstueck, Hackstueckstr. 123, 45527 Hattingen. The 2025 booking was one night with breakfast included; this 2026 plan needs two nights so day three can stay relaxed.

checkpoints.title: Dinner at Zum Hackstueck
checkpoints.subtitle: Easy hotel evening
checkpoints.detail: Keep the first evening simple after the ride. Reserve a table only after the room is confirmed.

checkpoints.title: Baldeneysee route to Messe Essen
checkpoints.subtitle: Zum Hackstueck to Messe Essen - 40 km
checkpoints.detail: Descend toward Hattingen, follow the Ruhr valley and Baldeneysee, then approach Messe Essen with a buffer before opening.

checkpoints.title: SPIEL Essen 2026
checkpoints.subtitle: Messe Essen - Thursday visitor day
checkpoints.detail: Official Thursday opening hours are 10:00-19:00. Keep a compact bag for purchases and confirm bicycle parking before departure.

checkpoints.title: Messe Essen to Essen Hbf
checkpoints.subtitle: Short evening bicycle transfer - 4 km
checkpoints.detail: Use lights and keep the evening bicycle leg deliberately short after the exhibition.

checkpoints.title: Essen Hbf
checkpoints.subtitle: Regional connection toward Hattingen - timetable to confirm
checkpoints.detail: Draft regional return. Recheck construction-adjusted trains and the local bicycle ticket before the trip.

checkpoints.title: Hattingen station to hotel
checkpoints.subtitle: Short evening finish - 7 km
checkpoints.detail: The final climb is short but dark in October. Use lights and keep a reflective layer easy to reach.

checkpoints.title: Hattingen to Essen slow Ruhr finale
checkpoints.subtitle: Hotel to Essen Hbf via Ruhr valley and Zollverein - 42 km
checkpoints.detail: Check out after breakfast, roll back through the Ruhr corridor, add a culture stop near Zollverein if the weather is good, then reach Essen Hbf with a wide buffer before the evening ICE.

checkpoints.title: Essen Hbf
checkpoints.subtitle: Evening ICE to Berlin Hbf - exact connection to book
checkpoints.detail: Draft evening window based on the 2025 Gmail pattern, where the return used Essen Hbf to Berlin Hbf with bicycle reservation. Book the long-distance bicycle space early.
